summary: Filter plugins manipulate data in Jinja2 and templates, can define several per file, don't use the standard config system (but can document since 2.14), and should re-raise undefined errors as AnsibleUndefinedVariable and others as AnsibleFilterError.
questions: Can I put several filters in one plugin file?
How should a filter plugin handle undefined variables?
Do filter plugins support configuration options?

answer_card.title: Filter plugins
